cards.example_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
cards.example_zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。
cards.explain_zh: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

cards.example_en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。
cards.explain_zh: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

cards.example_en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
cards.example_zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。
cards.explain_zh: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

cards.example_en: The heavy base keeps the lamp from falling over.
cards.example_zh: 沉重的底座让灯不易倒下。
cards.explain_zh: base A on B表示“以B为依据建立A”。

cards.example_en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
cards.example_zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
cards.explain_zh: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

cards.example_en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
cards.example_zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
cards.example_zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。
cards.explain_zh: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

cards.example_en: In past years our school held the fair in May.
cards.example_zh: 过去几年，我们学校都在五月举办义卖会。

cards.example_en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
cards.example_zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。
cards.explain_zh: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

cards.example_en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。
cards.explain_zh: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

cards.example_en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
cards.example_zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。
cards.explain_zh: 动词visit后直接接宾语；名词用a visit to。

cards.example_en: The community center offers free language classes.
cards.example_zh: 社区中心提供免费语言课程。

cards.example_en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
cards.example_zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。

cards.example_en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
cards.example_zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。
cards.explain_zh: nothing本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

cards.example_en: Please return these library books before you go away.
cards.example_zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。
cards.explain_zh: return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

cards.example_en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。
cards.explain_zh: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

cards.example_en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们每个星期天早上都步行去面包店。
cards.explain_zh: 字母l不发音；walk the dog意为遛狗。

cards.example_en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
cards.example_zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。
cards.explain_zh: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。

cards.example_en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
cards.example_zh: 你介意离开前把窗户关上吗？
cards.explain_zh: 表示介意做某事用mind doing，不用mind to do。

cards.example_en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
cards.example_zh: 这个结实的背包非常物有所值。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“价值观”用复数values。

cards.example_en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
cards.example_zh: 我把伞落在办公室的桌子下面了。
cards.explain_zh: 在办公室用in the office；任公职用in office。

cards.example_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
cards.example_zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。
cards.explain_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

cards.example_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
cards.example_zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
cards.example_zh: 比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。
cards.explain_zh: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

cards.example_en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
cards.example_zh: 大风把我的伞吹翻了。
cards.explain_zh: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。

cards.example_en: Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.
cards.example_zh: 随着人口增长，城市应改善公共交通，防止交通拥堵进一步恶化。
cards.explain_zh: stop doing是停止做；stop to do是停下去做。

cards.example_en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
cards.example_zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。
cards.explain_zh: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

cards.example_en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。
cards.explain_zh: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。

cards.example_en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
cards.example_zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。
cards.explain_zh: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

cards.example_en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 我至今还记得祖母厨房里的气味。
cards.explain_zh: remember to do是记得去做；doing是记得做过。

cards.example_en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
cards.example_zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。
cards.explain_zh: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

cards.example_en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
cards.example_zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
cards.example_zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。
cards.explain_zh: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

cards.example_en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
cards.example_zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
cards.example_zh: 我以为那只鸟是塑料的，没想到是真的。
cards.explain_zh: real修饰名词；表示“很、真正地”通常用really。

cards.example_en: Although average salaries have increased, rising prices mean that many workers have experienced a fall in real income.
cards.example_zh: 虽然平均工资上涨了，但物价上涨意味着许多劳动者的实际收入有所下降。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
cards.example_zh: 我问了价格，却没有人回答。
cards.explain_zh: 动词answer直接接问题；名词用the answer to。

cards.example_en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
cards.example_zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

cards.example_en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
cards.example_zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。
cards.explain_zh: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

cards.example_en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。
cards.explain_zh: letter既指信，也指字母；character还可指汉字等字符。

cards.example_en: Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
cards.example_zh: 撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
cards.example_zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。
cards.explain_zh: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

cards.example_en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
cards.example_zh: 邻居教我一点她的语言。
cards.explain_zh: 指某种语言时可数；泛指语言能力时常不可数。

cards.example_en: Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
cards.example_zh: 学习外语可以拓宽学生的文化视野，并改善他们未来的就业前景。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
cards.example_zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。
cards.explain_zh: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

cards.example_en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。
cards.explain_zh: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

cards.example_en: Regular play supports a young child's development in many ways.
cards.example_zh: 经常玩耍能从多方面促进幼儿的成长。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指发展通常不可数；表示新进展时可数。

cards.example_en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
cards.example_zh: 我们镇的老桥旁有一家面包店。
cards.explain_zh: go into town指去市中心，此时town前不加冠词。

cards.example_en: Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.
cards.example_zh: 改善小城镇的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会和基本服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.
word.example_zh: 准确的医疗记录让医护人员能够作出有依据的决定，避免不必要的治疗。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: The council invited residents to comment on urban development.
word.example_zh: 议会邀请居民就城市发展发表意见。

word.example_en: The city combines economic planning with sustainable development.
word.example_zh: 这座城市将经济规划与可持续发展结合起来。

word.example_en: Investment in public transport can support economic development while reducing traffic congestion in growing cities.
word.example_zh: 投资公共交通既能支持经济发展，也能缓解扩张中的城市的交通拥堵。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
